mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sudoku (open_id, game_mode, difficulty, index, puzzle, candidates, time_elapsed, status, miss_count, hint_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{openId}, #{gameMode}, #{difficulty}, #{index}, #{puzzle}, #{candidates}, #{timeElapsed}, #{status}, #{missCount}, #{hintCount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, open_id, game_mode, difficulty, index, puzzle, candidates, time_elapsed, status, miss_count, hint_count, create_time, update_time FROM sudoku WHERE open_id = #{openId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sudoku SET open_id = #{openId}, game_mode = #{gameMode}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, index = #{index}, puzzle = #{puzzle}, candidates = #{candidates}, time_elapsed = #{timeElapsed}, status = #{status}, miss_count = #{missCount}, hint_count = #{hintCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
